# fög Abstimmungsmonitor — V10.2 interim pilot

Reviewed printed cover dates and figure 1 on PDF page 2 of the seven original interim reports in 2021–22. Only the contemporaneous highlighted rows were transcribed (not historical comparison bars, whose numbers may be revised). 24 objects mapped to existing Swissvotes keys and dates. AHV reform combines two legal objects, so both receive identical aggregate tone and volume, counted once for relative prominence. The March 2021 window is 8 weeks; all others 9 weeks, according to figure captions. Date-level volume is not a count of unique articles across topics. Source dates are printed dates, not independently archived edition timestamps. Source URL, page, figure and labels are retained; reviewed CSV hash will be in result manifest. PDF byte hashes not yet captured. Source archive: https://www.foeg.uzh.ch/de/research/1-Aktuelle-Projekte/abstimmungsmonitor.html . Older interim reports listed 2016–20 were subsequently reviewed; no post-vote final reports or historical comparison bars used. No temporal change feature because only one verified snapshot per date so far.

Prespecified pilot: frozen V8.1 reference; historical residual bias-only control; tone; tone + log volume per week; tone + date-relative prominence. Ridge penalty 8, correction clipped to +/-10 pp, minimum six earlier covered objects and two distinct prior dates. All parameters fixed before scores. Missing media and insufficient history fall back to V8.1. Current-date ballots used only for scoring and later-date residuals. The model estimates historical aggregate outcomes only. No deployment.

## Extension 2016–2020

30 additional mapped objects from 12 interim reports, for 54 objects and 19 dates overall. June 2016 period rounded to 11 weeks; the other windows use the printed caption. Early March 2018 report dated 21 December 2017, financial-order tone derives from one article (interpret cautiously). September 2017 pension package and September 2022 AHV package each have two legal objects with identical report features; count each media label once for prominence. Page 3 of older slide reports is the first aggregate tone/volume chart (figure index 1); November 2020 is page 2. September 2018 values cross-checked with extracted report text; chart screenshot retrieval timed out. Missing: February 2016, February and May 2019, September 2020; no verified interim report identified in archive for these dates. Do not substitute post-vote results. No verified second snapshot yet, so change-in-tone hypothesis remains untested. All model parameters unchanged from pilot. Source availability is retrospective, not historically certified.
